description: Score an API's maturity 0-100 with a letter grade across design, governance coverage, documentation, and (from an apis.json) discoverability, agent-readiness, and operations. Pass your own `ruleset` — a score against rules you never adopted means little.

context.description: Optional: one sentence on the task you are doing. Never used to answer or rank; read only if a result is reported wrong.

document.description: The API description to operate on — OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, Arazzo or JSON Schema. A YAML/JSON string or an already-parsed object; both are accepted.

name: api_scorecard
